subject.title: Next Sprint B: model-input validation guardrails

question: Should configured model `input` metadata accept audio/video as valid catalog metadata while adding runtime capability guardrails, or should OpenClaw reject those modalities from `models.providers.*.models[*].input` by default?
rationale: Current source, tests, docs, and the open generated-catalog PR point in different directions, and tightening this surface can break existing config and provider catalog behavior.

options.title: Accept metadata, validate routing
options.body: Keep audio/video as valid metadata, but add catalog/probe/diagnostic checks before chat/media-understanding paths trust user-declared capabilities.

options.title: Reject unsupported inputs
options.body: Narrow configured model inputs back to supported runtime modalities and provide doctor/docs migration for existing audio/video config.

options.title: Require explicit override
options.body: Allow broader modalities only behind an explicit capability-override contract so accidental declarations fail closed without blocking intentional advanced use.

recommendation.title: Accept metadata, validate routing
recommendation.body: Keep audio/video as valid metadata, but add catalog/probe/diagnostic checks before chat/media-understanding paths trust user-declared capabilities.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans provider/config contracts and adjacent provider-catalog history where steipete has repeated relevant ownership signals.
